title: Relay mailbox receipt ACK returns 409 'native mailbox association is missing at its local home' after a successful read; persists after locator refresh
outcome: A domain session that reads a relay mailbox page can acknowledge that page with its unchanged receipt. If the acknowledgement cannot be recorded, the refusal names the actual missing association and a recovery that works, rather than a locator refresh that returns the same locator and the same refusal.
acceptance: Record a code-only diagnosis of the reported successful relay read followed by local-home association ACK refusal, distinguishing source-proved behavior from the incident's unavailable runtime metadata. Record the reporting session's single post-restart read/ACK result when supplied; use no new live probe, store access or other sessions' mailbox read.

A valid issued relay page receipt can be acknowledged by its original participant at its original mailbox/home through the existing authority path. Missing association metadata is distinguished from membership, identity, home and receipt failure; any refusal names the actual missing metadata and an applicable recovery rather than prescribing a locator refresh that cannot change the condition. No locator or receipt alone reconstructs membership or grants authority, and existing authentication, issuance, cursor, outcome-uncertainty and wake rules remain intact.

Deterministic behavioral tests cover successful read-to-ACK handling, the relevant missing-association failure/recovery path and unchanged-cursor controls for foreign/unissued receipts, wrong participant or home. The test fixture states which metadata-loss or routing boundary it injects; it does not claim that ordinary restart deletes metadata.

Record passing registered focused coverage on the final source, an independent Codex/Claude review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding, and a passing full five-stage gate on the exact final committed input before landing any repair.

completion.summary: Landed scoped relay ACK guidance and deterministic recovery controls in combo16; original historical association-loss cause remains unknown.
